tiers.A_clinical_guideline: Clinical guideline or guideline-backed marker. Display with clinical confirmation and clinician action warning.
tiers.A_clinically_actionable_gene_panel: Clinically meaningful when confirmed by validated sequencing or assay. Raw DNA is not sufficient.
tiers.A_clinical_guardrail: Safety rule. Always display/execute before marker interpretation when relevant.
tiers.A_rare_high_effect_when_confirmed: Rare variant can be high effect if clinically confirmed. Consumer array false positives/missingness are major concerns.
tiers.B_replicated_common_marker: Replicated common SNP/locus with modest effect. Show as context, not diagnosis.
tiers.B_polygenic_trait: Trait is polygenic. Requires weighted model, ancestry/platform calibration, and phenotype.
tiers.C_candidate_OR_mechanistic: Mechanistically plausible or candidate evidence. Use as weak context only.
tiers.D_research_only: Research-only. Do not score as actionable.

never_claim: absence of risk from missing marker
prefer_language: requires clinical confirmation if high stakes

unknown_tier.label: Evidence tier not classified
unknown_tier.description: The pack uses an unrecognized evidence label. Treat it as unvalidated until the pack is reviewed.

A.label: Tier A — Clinical / high evidence
A.description: Strongest evidence band in this app, but a raw consumer genotype still may require clinical confirmation and does not establish personal disease probability.
A.confidence_label: Higher evidence; personal impact still needs context

B.label: Tier B — Replicated context
B.description: Replicated or clinically relevant context with modest or conditional effects. This is not a diagnosis or a personal probability estimate.

C.label: Tier C — Preliminary
C.description: Limited, mechanistic, or biohacker-hypothesis evidence. Treat as a testable idea, not a fact or treatment instruction.

D.label: Tier D — Research Only
D.description: Early research. Not validated for clinical use.

E.label: Tier E — Guardrail / evidence gap
E.description: This entry exists to prevent an unsupported claim or to mark a known evidence gap. It should not be interpreted as a positive finding.

claim_frames.interpretation_blocked: Interpretation is blocked until the call and its evidence are verified.
claim_frames.clinical_confirmation: Clinical confirmation required: this raw consumer result is not a diagnosis, prognosis, dose, or treatment instruction.
claim_frames.B: Association context: replicated evidence can still have modest or conditional effects and is not a personal disease probability.
claim_frames.C: Preliminary context: hypothesis-level evidence; do not act on this marker alone.
claim_frames.D: Research context only: this marker is not validated for individual clinical use.
claim_frames.E: Guardrail: this entry marks an evidence gap or safety boundary, not a positive health finding.
claim_frames.unknown: Claim status is unclassified; do not act until the marker is reviewed.

risk.label: Risk Modifier
risk.description: This variant is associated with a higher likelihood of the described trait or condition.

protective.label: Protective Modifier
protective.description: This variant is associated with reduced risk or improved function.

context_dependent.label: Context-Dependent
context_dependent.description: The effect of this variant depends on other factors like diet, medication, or other genes.

trait.label: Trait Marker
trait.description: This variant is linked to a physical or behavioral characteristic, not a disease risk.

not_applicable.label: Not Applicable
not_applicable.description: An effect direction is not applicable to this marker.

no_claim.label: No Claim
no_claim.description: There is no clinical or health claim associated with this variant's direction.

unknown.label: Not Yet Classified
unknown.description: The direction of this variant's effect has not been definitively established.

high_risk.label: Two association alleles detected
high_risk.legend_description: Both copies match the researched association allele. Discuss with a healthcare provider if relevant.
high_risk.description: Both copies match the allele used by this pack's association rule. This is not a diagnosis or a personal disease probability.

moderate_risk.label: One association allele detected
moderate_risk.legend_description: One copy matches the association allele. Effect is usually smaller.
moderate_risk.description: One copy matches the allele used by this pack's association rule. Effects are usually smaller than two copies and remain context-dependent.

low_risk.label: Preliminary risk signal
low_risk.legend_description: Limited evidence should be treated as an early hypothesis, not a confirmed finding.
low_risk.description: Limited evidence (Tier D/E research). Treat this as an early hypothesis — not a confirmed finding. Consider discussing with your healthcare provider.

protective.label: Protective association detected
protective.legend_description: This variant may be linked to a beneficial or lower-association effect; protection is not guaranteed.
protective.description: This variant is associated with a potentially beneficial or lower-risk direction; it does not guarantee protection.

trait.label: Trait variant detected
trait.legend_description: Describes a personal characteristic, not a disease.
trait.description: This variant describes a characteristic, not a health risk.

context_dependent.label: Context-dependent variant
context_dependent.legend_description: The effect depends on other factors like diet, medications, or lifestyle.
context_dependent.description: This variant's effect depends on other factors like medications, diet, or environment.

confirmation_required.label: Clinical confirmation needed
confirmation_required.plain_label: Needs clinical lab test to verify
confirmation_required.legend_description: Consumer DNA chips can report false positives. A clinical lab test is required.
confirmation_required.description: Consumer DNA tests can produce false positives on rare variants. A clinical lab test is needed to confirm.

no_data.label: No data available
no_data.legend_description: Your DNA file did not include data for this position.
no_data.description: Your DNA test did not include or could not read this position.

not_evaluated.label: Not evaluated
not_evaluated.legend_description: The raw call may be present, but this assertion does not define a matchable rule for this report.
not_evaluated.description: This assertion was not scored because its allele or assay requirement is not represented by the current evaluator.

benign.label: Variant not detected
benign.legend_description: The effect allele was not found at this position; the card is collapsed since no action is needed.
benign.description: Your genotype at this position matches the standard reference. The effect allele being tested was not found.
